title: CJP protest 2.0: Supreme Court holds special Sunday sitting to hear contempt plea, detentions - All you need to know
summary: The petition seeks initiation of contempt proceedings against Home Secretary, Delhi Police Commissioner, and DMRC Chairperson for alleged willful disobedience of the Supreme Court's directions.
